def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for dr, dc in ((1,1),(1,-1)):
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                color=grid[r][c]
                if color==bg: continue
                rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
                if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and grid[rr][cc]==color:
                    # continue the two-cell diagonal segment outward at each end
                    for sr,sc in ((-dr,-dc),(dr,dc)):
                        nr,nc=(r,c) if (sr,sc)==(-dr,-dc) else (rr,cc)
                        nr,nc=nr+sr,nc+sc
                        while 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and grid[nr][nc]==bg:
                            out[nr][nc]=color
                            nr,nc=nr+sr,nc+sc
    return out
PY
